claim_status: Attachment formula is a hypothesis until its exact assumptions and native mapping are checked; not inherited as a proved result.
task_information: Task known before selecting one complete legal gear configuration; unchanged native APL available to all old and new gear.
policies: One source-grounded native damage APL per class, same on both sides; a policy-restricted study, not optimization over all possible player control.
utility: Mean native total damage per encounter duration, including native pet contribution where reported by engine; no health-survival or generic wave/movement claim.

capacity_estimands.T_utility: P/H/G complete-library frontier capacity for the frozen incoming family.
capacity_estimands.T_value_legacy: P/N/L/H/C/G capacity; source obligations may reduce the utility-only formula.
capacity_estimands.T_joint: Adds the retained original behavioral D check. No scalar-output formula is claimed to imply D. Native cross-class behavioral features and any unavailable original rage coordinate will be explicitly scoped.

prediction_scope: Conditional on affine response reduction and exact accessible-band/source-retention checks; table records transfer failures separately.

compatibility_rule.semantic_scope: Research admission budget over two actual component amplitude contributions; it changes gear access, not native combat physics. Old primary amplifier contribution is zero, so all old crosses remain legal.
compatibility_rule.status: Theoretical validation pending before final future-design freeze; if invalid, preserve the failure instead of tuning from native outcomes.

calibration.allocation_validation: Same positive total bonus split across the two actual slots; unchanged total response/control checked.

execution.future_design_freeze: Per-context native scale and all candidate configurations frozen after calibration, before any confirmation outcomes.

aggregation: Matched ecology/update family is scientific unit. Class-equal faction summaries; combat seeds quantify simulation noise only. Unsupported/incomplete checkpoints are not_run, never zero capacity.
scope_limits: All56 have a successful support smoke, not capacity results yet. HighOrder regeneration and Gnome non-mana pool racial omissions remain flagged. Weapon-speed, mana-generation and true item-trigger/pet interactions require independent native family validation; three stat parameter ranges do not count as mechanism diversity.
